faqs.question: What is a PDF Merge tool?
faqs.answer: A PDF Merge tool combines two or more separate PDF files into a single PDF document. This tool does all of that processing directly in your browser — no file upload to a server is required.

faqs.question: Can I merge PDF files online?
faqs.answer: Yes. This is a browser-based pdf merge online tool. Select your files, arrange their order, click Merge PDFs, and download the result. Everything runs client-side, so you do not need to upload your documents anywhere.

faqs.question: Is this PDF Merge tool free?
faqs.answer: Yes. This pdf merge free utility is available to use at no cost and requires no account or subscription. You can merge PDFs directly from your browser without any registration.

faqs.question: Can I merge two PDF files into one?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add two PDF files using the file picker or drag and drop, then click Merge PDFs. The tool will combine them into a single downloadable PDF document.

faqs.question: Can I change the order of PDF files before merging?
faqs.answer: Yes. After adding your files, use the Move Up and Move Down buttons on each row to arrange them in the order you want. The final merged PDF will follow that order exactly.

faqs.question: Are my PDF files uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Your PDF files are processed entirely within your browser using client-side JavaScript and the pdf-lib library. The files are read into your browser's memory only and are never transmitted to any server.

faqs.question: Can I merge large PDF files?
faqs.answer: This tool can handle moderately large PDF files depending on the available memory in your browser and device. Very large files (for example, hundreds of megabytes combined) may slow down the merge process or trigger a browser memory warning. If that happens, try merging fewer files at a time.

faqs.question: Can I merge password-protected PDFs?
faqs.answer: No. Password-protected or encrypted PDF files cannot be processed by this tool. The PDF library requires the full document to be accessible. Remove the password protection from your PDFs before attempting to merge them.

faqs.question: Does PDF merging reduce the quality of my documents?
faqs.answer: No. This tool copies PDF pages directly without rasterizing or re-encoding the content. Text, vector graphics, and embedded images are preserved as they appear in the original documents.

faqs.question: Can I download the merged PDF?
faqs.answer: Yes. After the merge completes, a Download Merged PDF button appears. Clicking it saves the combined PDF file directly to your device. No automatic download happens without your action.

en.contentHtml:
PDF Merge Online

This PDF merge online tool lets you combine multiple PDF documents into a single file without leaving your browser. There is nothing to install and no account required. Simply select your PDF files, choose their order, and download the merged result. Because the entire process happens client-side, your documents stay on your device.

The tool is available as a pdf merge free utility — you can use it as many times as you need for personal or professional documents. Whether you are combining scanned pages, joining reports, or consolidating project files, the process takes only a few clicks.

🔒

Files Stay Private

PDFs are read directly in your browser's memory and are never transmitted to any server.

📋

Reorder Before Merging

Move files up or down in the list so the merged PDF comes out in exactly the order you need.

⚡

No Quality Loss

Pages are copied directly — text, graphics, and embedded images remain unchanged.

How to Merge PDF Files

Combining PDFs with this tool is straightforward. Follow these steps:

You can add multiple files at once.' }, { step: '2', title: 'Review the File List', desc: 'Each added PDF appears in the list with its filename and size.' }, { step: '3', title: 'Arrange the Order', desc: 'Use the ↑ and ↓ buttons to reorder files. The merged PDF will follow this sequence.' }, { step: '4', title: 'Click Merge PDFs', desc: 'Press the Merge PDFs button. The browser combines the documents in your chosen order.' }, { step: '5', title: 'Download the Result', desc: 'Once complete, click Download Merged PDF to save the combined file to your device.' }, ].map(({ step, title, desc }) => (

PDF to PDF Merge

A pdf to pdf merge operation takes multiple existing PDF files and assembles them into one cohesive document. Unlike converting other formats to PDF, this process works entirely within the PDF format — each source file contributes its pages to the new combined document in the order you specify.

This tool uses the open-source pdf-lib library to copy pages from each source document into a freshly created PDF. The page dimensions and content of each original file are preserved in the output. A pdf to pdf merge in this sense is additive: the merged file contains all the pages from all source files, nothing is removed or re-encoded.

Free PDF Merge Tool

This pdf merge free tool runs entirely in your browser with no subscription or sign-up required. You can merge PDF files for personal documents, work reports, academic assignments, or any other purpose at no charge.

Because the tool is browser-based, there are practical limits tied to your device's available memory rather than any artificial restriction imposed by the service. For most everyday documents, the tool works quickly and without issues. Very large combined file sets may require more processing time.

Why Merge PDF Files?

There are many practical reasons to combine separate PDF documents into one:

{icon} {title}

{desc}

))}

Is PDF Merge Safe?

This implementation processes PDF files locally inside your browser. No network request carrying your PDF data is made by the tool. The server delivers the static page and JavaScript assets only — it has no visibility into the files you select or the content of those files.

What this tool does NOT do:

  • Upload PDF files to any server or cloud service
  • Store PDF content in cookies, localStorage, or a database
  • Send file data to analytics platforms
  • Transmit file names or sizes as identifying information

If you are working with sensitive or confidential documents, a client-side tool of this kind is preferable to services that require uploading files to a remote server.

How Does PDF Merging Work?

When you click Merge PDFs, the browser reads each selected file using the FileReader API and loads its raw binary bytes into the pdf-lib client-side parser. The engine instantiates a new, empty PDF document and copies individual page objects from each source document in the exact sequence shown in your list. Once all pages are compiled, the combined document is serialized into a byte array and exposed as an instant, downloadable Blob URL.

Pages are copied directly as native PDF page dictionaries and vector streams, not rasterized to flat bitmap images. This ensures that text remains 100% selectable and searchable, vector graphics remain sharp at any zoom level, and embedded images retain their full original resolution and color profiles.

1. In-Memory Parsing

ArrayBuffer Stream

Files are loaded directly into browser memory. Zero document data is sent to an external server.

2. Lossless Cloning

Page Object Tree

copyPages() clones fonts, annotations, and vector streams directly without re-compression.

3. Fast Assembly

Client Blob URL

The compiled byte buffer is wrapped in an application/pdf Blob for instant 1-click download.

faqs.question: क्या मैं ऑनलाइन PDF फाइलों को मर्ज कर सकता हूँ?
faqs.answer: हाँ। फाइलें चुनें, उनका क्रम तय करें और 'Merge PDFs' पर क्लिक करके डाउनलोड करें। सारी प्रक्रिया सीधे आपके ब्राउज़र में होती है।

faqs.question: क्या यह PDF मर्ज टूल मुफ्त है?
faqs.answer: हाँ, यह 100% फ्री है और किसी लॉगिन या सदस्यता की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

faqs.question: क्या दो PDF फाइलों को एक में जोड़ा जा सकता है?
faqs.answer: हाँ, दो या उससे अधिक फाइलों को आसानी से जोड़कर एक फाइल बनाई जा सकती है।

faqs.question: क्या मर्ज करने से पहले फाइलों का क्रम बदला जा सकता है?
faqs.answer: हाँ, 'Move Up' और 'Move Down' बटनों से आप अपनी इच्छानुसार पेजों और फाइलों का क्रम व्यवस्थित कर सकते हैं।

faqs.question: क्या मेरी PDF फाइलें सर्वर पर अपलोड होती हैं?
faqs.answer: नहीं। pdf-lib लाइब्रेरी द्वारा पूरी प्रक्रिया 100% आपके डिवाइस की मेमोरी में स्थानीय रूप से पूरी होती है।

faqs.question: क्या बड़ी PDF फाइलें जोड़ी जा सकती हैं?
faqs.answer: हाँ, यह मध्यम और बड़ी फाइलों को आसानी से संभाल सकता है।

faqs.question: क्या पासवर्ड से सुरक्षित PDF मर्ज हो सकती हैं?
faqs.answer: नहीं, मर्ज करने से पहले आपको PDF से पासवर्ड हटाना होगा।

faqs.question: क्या PDF की गुणवत्ता कम होती है?
faqs.answer: नहीं, टेक्स्ट, वेक्टर ग्राफिक्स और फोटो की मूल गुणवत्ता 100% सुरक्षित रहती है।

faqs.question: क्या मर्ज की गई PDF तुरंत डाउनलोड हो जाती है?

faqs.question: ¿Qué es una herramienta para unir PDF (PDF Merge)?
faqs.answer: Es un servicio que permite combinar múltiples documentos PDF independientes en un único archivo consolidado.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo unir varios archivos PDF gratis online?
faqs.answer: Arrastra tus documentos PDF a la herramienta, ordénalos según tu preferencia y haz clic en 'Combinar PDF' para descargarlo de inmediato.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo cambiar el orden de las páginas antes de unirlas?
faqs.answer: Sí, puedes arrastrar y reorganizar los archivos o eliminar páginas no deseadas antes de la consolidación final.

faqs.question: ¿Hay límite de páginas o tamaño de archivo?
faqs.answer: Sin límites estrictos; puedes unir decenas de documentos en un solo paso.

faqs.question: ¿Se reduce la calidad de los documentos al combinarlos?
faqs.answer: No. Se preservan intactas las fuentes tipográficas, vectores y calidad de resolución original.

faqs.question: ¿Se suben mis archivos confidenciales a servidores externos?
faqs.answer: No. Toda la unión de documentos ocurre en tu propio navegador de forma 100% privada sin subir nada a la nube.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo unir PDFs con contraseñas o firmas digitales?
faqs.answer: Los archivos protegidos deben desbloquearse previamente con la contraseña correcta para poder procesar sus páginas.

faqs.question: ¿Es gratis o requiere registro?
faqs.answer: Totalmente gratuito, sin suscripciones, sin registros y sin marcas de agua publicitarias.

faqs.question: ¿Funciona en teléfonos móviles?
faqs.answer: Sí, funciona de manera fluida en navegadores móviles de smartphones y tablets.

faqs.question: ¿Se conservan los enlaces y marcadores originales?
faqs.answer: Sí, los enlaces internos y la estructura de navegación se mantienen en el documento unificado resultante.

faqs.question: PDF結合ツール（PDF Merge）とは何ですか？
faqs.answer: 複数の独立したPDFファイルを1つのまとまったPDF文書に結合・統合するオンラインツールです。

faqs.question: 無料で複数のPDFを結合する方法は？
faqs.answer: PDFファイルをドラッグ＆ドロップし、希望の並び順に整えて「PDFを結合」ボタンを押すだけで完了します。

faqs.question: 結合前にページの並び順を変更できますか？
faqs.answer: はい。プレビューをドラッグして直感的に順序を入れ替えたり、不要なファイルを削除できます。

faqs.question: ページ数やファイルサイズの制限はありますか？
faqs.answer: 実質的な制限はなく、多くのページを含む複数ファイルを一度に結合できます。

faqs.question: 結合によって文字や画像の画質は劣化しますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ。フォントのベクター情報や画像解像度は元の品質のまま保持されます。

faqs.question: 機密書類がサーバーにアップロードされる危険はありますか？
faqs.answer: 一切ありません。結合処理は100%お使いのブラウザ（ローカル）で処理されるため、極めて安全です。

faqs.question: パスワード保護されたPDFも結合できますか？
faqs.answer: 暗号化されたPDFは、パスワードを入力して解除した後に結合可能となります。

faqs.question: 利用料や透かし（ウォーターマーク）はありますか？
faqs.answer: 完全無料です。利用制限や余計な透かしが入ることはありません。

faqs.question: スマートフォンからでも利用できますか？
faqs.answer: はい。iPhoneやAndroidなどのスマートフォンブラウザからも快適に操作可能です。

faqs.question: 元ファイル内のリンクやしおり（目次）は維持されますか？
faqs.answer: はい。内部ハイパーリンクや文書構造は結合後のファイルにもそのまま引き継がれます。

ファイルはサーバーにアップロードされますか？

いいえ。すべての処理はブラウザ内でローカルに行われます。ファイルはアップロードされません。

品質は低下しますか？

いいえ。PDFを結合しても元のコンテンツの品質に影響しません。

一度に何個のPDFファイルを結合できますか？

PDF結合は無料ですか？

faqs.question: La qualité du texte et des images est-elle conservée ?

faqs.question: Mes documents confidentiels sont-ils protégés ?

faqs.question: Peut-on fusionner des PDF protégés par mot de passe ?
faqs.answer: Le mot de passe doit être saisi pour autoriser la lecture des pages avant l'assemblage.

faqs.question: L'outil est-il gratuit et sans filigrane ?
faqs.answer: 100% gratuit, sans inscription préalable et sans ajout de logo promotionnel.

faqs.question: Est-ce compatible avec les appareils mobiles ?
faqs.answer: Entièrement fonctionnel sur iOS, Android, macOS et Windows.

faqs.question: Les signets et liens interactifs sont-ils préservés ?
faqs.answer: Oui, la structure de navigation interne reste active dans le document final.

faqs.question: Was ist ein PDF-Zusammenfügen-Tool (PDF Merge)?
faqs.answer: Ein Werkzeug zum Zusammenführen mehrerer einzelner PDF-Dokumente zu einer einzigen strukturierten Datei.

faqs.question: Wie kann man mehrere PDF-Dateien online kostenlos zusammenfügen?
faqs.answer: PDFs hochladen, per Drag & Drop in die gewünschte Reihenfolge bringen und auf 'PDF zusammenfügen' klicken.

faqs.question: Kann die Seitenreihenfolge vorab geändert werden?
faqs.answer: Ja, Dokumente und Seiten lassen sich beliebig verschieben oder entfernen.

faqs.question: Gibt es Begrenzungen für Dateigröße oder Seitenzahl?
faqs.answer: Keine praktischen Einschränkungen für normale Büro- und Studienunterlagen.

faqs.question: Geht beim Zusammenführen Text- oder Bildqualität verloren?
faqs.answer: Nein, Schriften, Vektoren und Grafiken bleiben in nativer Auflösung erhalten.

faqs.question: Werden vertrauliche Dokumente hochgeladen?
faqs.answer: Nein. Alle Operationen laufen lokal in Ihrem Browser über JavaScript ab; keine Datenübertragung.

faqs.question: Können passwortgeschützte PDFs verbunden werden?
faqs.answer: Geschützte Dateien müssen zuvor mit dem gültigen Passwort freigegeben werden.

faqs.question: Kostet die Nutzung etwas oder entstehen Wasserzeichen?
faqs.answer: Vollständig kostenlos ohne Werbung, Wasserzeichen oder Registrierungszwang.

faqs.question: Funktioniert das Tool auf Smartphones?
faqs.answer: Ja, uneingeschränkt nutzbar auf Android, iPhone und Tablets.

faqs.question: Bleiben Hyperlinks und Lesezeichen erhalten?
faqs.answer: Ja, bestehende Verknüpfungen und Gliederungspunkte werden in das Zieldokument übernommen.

de.contentHtml:
PDF Online Zusammenfuhren - Mehrere PDFs zu einer Datei Kombinieren

Kombinieren Sie mehrere PDF-Dokumente direkt im Browser zu einer Datei. Keine Installation, kein Server-Upload. Ihre Dokumente bleiben vollstandig privat.

Verwendung

  1. Laden Sie Ihre PDF-Dateien hoch
  2. Ordnen Sie die Reihenfolge per Drag-and-Drop
  3. Klicken Sie auf Zusammenfuhren
  4. Laden Sie das zusammengefuhrte PDF herunter

Hauptfunktionen

  • Vollstandige Verarbeitung im Browser
  • Keine Dateigroenbeschrankung
  • Drag-and-Drop-Organisation
  • Erhalt die ursprungliche Qualitat und Formatierung

FAQ

Werden Dateien auf den Server hochgeladen?

Nein. Die gesamte Verarbeitung findet lokal in Ihrem Browser statt. Ihre Dateien werden nie hochgeladen.

Verliert die Qualitat?

Nein. Das Zusammenfuhren von PDFs beeinflusst die Qualitat des Originalinhalts nicht.

Wie viele PDF-Dateien konnen auf einmal kombiniert werden?

Keine Begrenzung, obwohl sehr grose Dateien im Browser langsamer sein konnen.

Ist PDF zusammenfuhren kostenlos?

Ja, vollstandig kostenlos, keine Anmeldung oder Abonnement erforderlich.

faqs.question: O que é uma ferramenta de juntar PDF (PDF Merge)?
faqs.answer: É um utilitário para agrupar múltiplos arquivos PDF independentes em um único documento completo.

faqs.question: Como juntar vários arquivos PDF grátis online?
faqs.answer: Arraste seus PDFs para a tela, ordene na sequência desejada e clique em 'Juntar PDF' para salvar.

faqs.question: Posso reordenar as páginas antes de mesclar?
faqs.answer: Sim, reposicione os arquivos arrastando-os facilmente até atingir a ordem desejada.

faqs.question: Há restrição de páginas ou tamanho de arquivo?
faqs.answer: Não há limites rígidos; junte dezenas de páginas com tranquilidade.

faqs.question: A qualidade dos gráficos e fontes é preservada?
faqs.answer: Sim, sem perda de resolução ou distorção tipográfica.

faqs.question: Meus documentos pessoais sobem para algum servidor?
faqs.answer: Não. A mesclagem opera 100% no seu navegador com sigilo e segurança garantidos.

faqs.question: Dá para unir PDFs protegidos por senha?
faqs.answer: Arquivos criptografados exigem a inserção prévia da senha para desbloqueio.

faqs.question: O serviço aplica marcas d'água no PDF final?
faqs.answer: Nenhuma marca d'água é inserida; o arquivo final permanece limpo e profissional.

faqs.question: Funciona no celular?
faqs.answer: Sim, compatibilidade perfeita com smartphones Android e iOS.

faqs.question: Os links e sumários são mantidos?
faqs.answer: Sim, links internos e estrutura documental são preservados no arquivo unificado.

pt.contentHtml:
Unir PDF Online - Combine Varios PDFs em Um Unico Arquivo

Combine varios documentos PDF em um unico arquivo diretamente no navegador. Sem instalacao, sem upload para servidor. Seus documentos permanecem completamente privados.

Como usar

  1. Envie seus arquivos PDF
  2. Organize a ordem com arrastar e soltar
  3. Clique no botao Mesclar
  4. Baixe o PDF mesclado

Principais recursos

  • Processamento completo no navegador
  • Sem limite de tamanho de arquivo
  • Organizacao com arrastar e soltar
  • Manteve a qualidade e formatacao originais

FAQ

Os arquivos sao enviados ao servidor?

Nao. Todo o processamento ocorre localmente no seu navegador. Seus arquivos nunca sao enviados.

A qualidade piora?

Nao. Mesclar PDFs nao afeta a qualidade do conteudo original.

Quantos arquivos PDF podem ser combinados de uma vez?

Sem limite, embora arquivos muito grandes possam ser mais lentos no navegador.

Mesclar PDF e gratuito?

Sim, completamente gratuito, sem necessidade de cadastro ou assinatura.

faqs.question: PDF 병합(PDF Merge) 도구는 어떻게 작동하나요?
faqs.answer: 여러 개의 개별 PDF 문서를 순서대로 합쳐 하나의 통일된 완성본 PDF로 병합해주는 도구입니다.

faqs.question: 온라인에서 무료로 PDF를 합치는 방법은?
faqs.answer: 병합할 PDF 파일들을 끌어다 놓고 원하는 순서로 정렬한 뒤 'PDF 병합' 버튼을 누르면 즉시 다운로드됩니다.

faqs.question: 병합하기 전에 문서 순서를 변경할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네. 마우스 드래그를 통해 페이지 및 파일 순서를 자유롭게 재배치할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 페이지 수나 파일 용량에 제한이 있나요?
faqs.answer: 업무 및 학습용 대용량 문서도 제한 없이 자유롭게 병합할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 합친 후 텍스트나 이미지 화질이 저하되나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요. 원본 문서의 벡터 폰트와 고해상도 그래픽 품질이 그대로 유지됩니다.

faqs.question: 개인정보나 중요 문서가 서버로 유출될 위험은 없나요?
faqs.answer: 전혀 없습니다. 모든 병합 작업이 사용자의 웹 브라우저 내부에서만 실행되므로 안전합니다.

faqs.question: 비밀번호가 걸려 있는 암호화된 PDF도 병합되나요?
faqs.answer: 암호화된 문서는 먼저 올바른 비밀번호를 입력하여 잠금을 해제한 후 병합할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 워터마크가 찍히거나 유료 결제가 필요한가요?
faqs.answer: 가입이나 결제 없이 100% 무료이며 어떠한 워터마크도 생성되지 않습니다.

faqs.question: 스마트폰이나 태블릿에서도 쓸 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네. 모바일 기기에서도 동일하게 빠르고 편리하게 이용할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 문서 내부 링크나 목차 정보가 보존되나요?
faqs.answer: 네. 내부 하이퍼링크 및 북마크 구조가 합쳐진 최종 문서에도 그대로 유지됩니다.

ko.contentHtml:
PDF 온라인으로 합치기 - 여러 PDF를 하나의 파일로 결합

브라우저에서 여러 PDF 문서를 하나의 파일로 결합합니다. 설치 불필요, 서버 업로드 없음. 문서는 완전히 비공개로 유지됩니다.

사용 방법

  1. PDF 파일을 업로드하세요
  2. 드래그 앤 드롭으로 순서를 정리하세요
  3. 병합 버튼을 클릭하세요
  4. 병합된 PDF를 다운로드하세요

주요 기능

  • 브라우저 내에서 완전히 처리
  • 파일 크기 제한 없음
  • 드래그 앤 드롭으로 정리
  • 원본 품질과 형식 유지

FAQ

파일이 서버에 업로드됩니까?

아니요. 모든 처리는 브라우저 내에서 로컬로 이루어집니다. 파일은 업로드되지 않습니다.

품질이 저하됩니까?

아니요. PDF 병합은 원본 콘텐츠의 품질에 영향을 미치지 않습니다.

한 번에 몇 개의 PDF 파일을 결합할 수 있습니까?

제한 없음, 매우 큰 파일은 브라우저에서 더 느릴 수 있습니다.

PDF 병합은 무료입니까?

네, 완전히 무료입니다. 가입이나 구독이 필요 없습니다.

faqs.question: Che cos'è uno strumento per unire PDF (PDF Merge)?
faqs.answer: Un'utilità che permette di fondere più documenti PDF separati in un unico archivio continuo.

faqs.question: Come unire più PDF gratis online?
faqs.answer: Trascina i file PDF nell'interfaccia, imposta l'ordine di lettura e clicca su 'Unisci PDF' per scaricare il risultato.

faqs.question: Posso cambiare la sequenza dei documenti?
faqs.answer: Sì, puoi riordinare o eliminare elementi tramite intuitivo trascinamento.

faqs.question: Esistono limiti al numero di pagine unibili?
faqs.answer: Nessun vincolo restrittivo per la combinazione di più documenti.

faqs.question: La nitidezza del testo viene compromessa?
faqs.answer: Nessun degrado: vettorialità e qualità delle immagini rimangono inalterate.

faqs.question: I documenti vengono trasferiti online?
faqs.answer: No, la procedura si conclude interamente all'interno del browser senza invio di dati.

faqs.question: È possibile unire PDF protetti da password?
faqs.answer: Sì, purché si fornisca la password corretta per consentire la lettura delle pagine.

faqs.question: Il servizio inserisce filigrane nei PDF?
faqs.answer: Assolutamente no: il file generato è pulito e privo di loghi esterni.

faqs.question: È compatibile con smartphone e tablet?
faqs.answer: Sì, fruibile agevolmente da qualsiasi dispositivo mobile.

faqs.question: I segnalibri e i link ipertestuali rimangono attivi?
faqs.answer: Sì, i riferimenti interni e i collegamenti ipertestuali vengono mantenuti.

it.contentHtml:
Unisci PDF Online - Combina Piu PDF in Un Unico File

Combina piu documenti PDF in un unico file direttamente nel browser. Nessuna installazione, nessun caricamento al server. I tuoi documenti rimangono completamente privati.

Come usare

  1. Carica i tuoi file PDF
  2. Organizza l'ordine con trascina e rilascia
  3. Clicca sul pulsante Unisci
  4. Scarica il PDF unito

Funzionalita principali

  • Elaborazione completa nel browser
  • Nessun limite di dimensione del file
  • Organizzazione con trascina e rilascia
  • Mantiene la qualita e la formattazione originali

FAQ

I file vengono caricati sul server?

No. Tutta l'elaborazione avviene localmente nel tuo browser. I tuoi file non vengono mai caricati.

La qualita peggiora?

No. L'unione di PDF non influisce sulla qualita del contenuto originale.

Quanti file PDF si possono combinare alla volta?

Nessun limite, anche se file molto grandi possono essere piu lenti nel browser.

Unire PDF e gratuito?

Si, completamente gratuito, senza necessita di registrazione o abbonamento.
